title: randia clusiifolia
intro: Randia clusiifolia, commonly known as Yellow Birdwood or Randia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Randia clusiifolia include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
